integrity_note: Exact structural and counting proofs are given; standalone direct-propagation enumeration checks small cases and exact mixed moments. A finite checker is not a substitute for the infinite-family argument. No independent audit or validation has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary graph power domination only, with uniformly random cell sensors under independent Bernoulli or uniform fixed-cardinality placement. The probabilistic transition is asymptotic for \(m\ge n\) tending to infinity; the scalar minimum was previously known. The complete 2014 diameter-two paper and 2008 publisher full text were not accessible, leaving residual originality uncertainty.
title: A near-square Poisson crossover for random power domination of rook graphs
